canonical_statement: For every integer n from 2 through 100, provide explicitly a graph on 4n-2 labelled vertices containing no book B_(n-1), while its complement contains no book B_n, where B_t consists of t triangles sharing an edge. Graphs are supplied as column-major upper-triangle adjacency strings. This finite explicit-output profile tests the public n<=100 behavior but does not by itself provide the requested general algorithm for all n.
success_criterion: amf.book.range100.v1 checks all 99 exact graph strings and accepts after confirming that every graph edge has fewer than n-1 common neighbors and every nonedge has fewer than n common nonneighbors. Novelty and the stronger all-n algorithm claim require separate review.
partial_progress_criterion: Retain any newly verified previously uncovered n, a reusable construction family, improved search code, and rigorous reductions explaining why a family avoids the two book graphs.
stop_conditions: The moving public progress log makes the chosen finite range entirely redundant.
The official adjacency ordering or book convention changes.
The separately approved experiment budget is exhausted.
